definitions.x_news_count: observed articles per trading day; zero means no collected article
definitions.x_domestic_count: lead first 200 words mentions rupiah, Bank Indonesia, or USD/IDR
definitions.x_macro_count: title + lead mentions predefined monetary/FX anchors (not validated relevance)
definitions.x_usd_title: mean lexical USD direction in title; + strengthening, - weakening
definitions.x_usd_lead: mean lexical USD direction in first 200 words
definitions.x_usd_full: mean lexical USD direction across stored full text (contamination sensitivity)
definitions.x_fed_tilt: mean hawkish-minus-dovish lexical count, gated on Fed mention, first 200 words
